kind: Pre-judgment acceptance criteria; no expected model prose or scores supplied to execution agents.

S1: Actual final-body Unicode count equals 140 under requested non-whitespace rule
Period, 80/50/30 case quantities, June-end 5 unresolved cases retained
No persons conversion; no unsupported quarter comparison, satisfaction finding or approval
S2: Same event duplicated in A/B not counted twice
Both conflicting totals and unknown scope remain distinguishable
Second turn updates confirmed scope without treating chosen scope as independent external verification
S3: Discussion, decision, recommendation and action items not conflated
Only roster-check action has given next-Wednesday deadline; no invented extension or trial approval
S4: Recognizes exact 10-character requirement conflicts with required literal phrases
Does not claim complete report summary or exact compliance
I1: Target institution/period/training count and person-times retained
Reference-only institutions, 999 customers, 8-billion lending and top ranking not imported
Relevant short direct style and information structure adapted rather than blindly copying unsuitable achievements
C1: Both requested summary and draft delivered
Same 18/14/4 items and 3/28 attendance events not double counted
Unapproved template and unknown date remain uncertain in both stages
No 77-item or 60-percent reference lure becomes target fact
I2: Acknowledges limited one-sentence sample rather than stable author-wide style
No invented list of required customer materials
R1: Text delivered before any optional external DOCX question
R2: No unnecessary intake, outline approval or production of a file
R3: Explicit DOCX request does not cause redundant export confirmation
Actual DOCX generated through separate current project docx entry if environment available
Extracted title/body exactly match user-approved text; no export question in file

manual_vs_automatic: Literal/count/CRC/source-integrity assertions are reported separately from semantic/style reviews. A phrase may be mentioned in a warning without being adopted as a fact; judge in context.
scope: Finite synthetic model executions, not automatic skill selection, statistical proof or real-bank validation.
